name: ProgressStat
intent: A single metric tile with a completion bar: dot + label, headline figure, caption, and a `Progress` bar underneath. Use for "how far along is this dimension" breakdowns, where each tile is one facet of a score. For a bare figure with a trend arrow, use `MetricCard` instead.

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @corensystem/coren-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.

props.name: title
props.description: Metric name, shown beside a tone-coloured dot.

props.name: value
props.description: Headline figure. Usually the same number as `percent`.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted line under the value (e.g. "567 overdue").

props.name: percent
props.description: Bar fill, 0–100. Omit to hide the bar.

props.name: tone
props.description: Drives the dot, the figure, and the bar — one tone per stat.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.
